source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ss.1 ("קופת גמל בניהול אישי"), 13, 39, 57 (Wikisource mirror)

regulator.notes: A self-directed study fund is a study fund approved under s.13(א) of the Provident Funds Law for one member who directs its investments (s.1 'קופת גמל בניהול אישי'); its managing company is under the CMA Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)). The broker inside the account is a TASE member or bank under its own regulator.

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 4 (Hebrew Wikisource; cross-read on Nevo)

balance.notes: Management Fees Regulations 2012, reg. 4: a managing company of a keren hishtalmut or an IRA (קופת גמל בניהול אישי) may charge 'בשיעור שלא יעלה על 2% לשנה' of the balance. Reg. 4 covers an IRA fund at 2% of the balance, with no deposit-fee item (PF-06, IRA-17). The member's own agreement sets the rate (IRA-17); Gemel-Net 202609 averages for IRA funds run 0.15% to 0.36%.

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 4 (Hebrew Wikisource; cross-read on Nevo)

deposit.notes: Reading, not a quoted figure: regulation 4 authorises a fee from the balance only and has no fee-from-deposits item, and law s.32(א) forbids any charge not allowed (PF-06). No IRA fund reports a deposit fee in Gemel-Net 202609 (IRA-17).

source.title: IRA regulations, regs. 7 (closed list of charges), 12 (competitive process) (Nevo mirror, summarising fetch)

trade.notes: No cap. Buy and sell commissions are charged to the fund on top of the management fee, at the tariff of the broker the member picks: one of the winners of the managing company's competitive process (at least every 3 years, at least 8 participants since 2017), or, under reg. 12(ג) as replaced in 2017, another broker the member chooses after being shown the winners' terms (IRA-18, updated 2026-10-25). Meitav's 2026 tariffs per broker are in IRA-21 and belong in data/fees/ (R4).

source.title: IRA regulations, regs. 7 (closed list of charges), 12 (competitive process) (Nevo mirror, summarising fetch)

custody.notes: No cap beyond: custody fees may not exceed what the same managing company's non-IRA funds pay (reg. 7(א)(2), 2017). Meitav Trade exempts custody inside an IRA; bank brokers charge per their tariff (IRA OQ6).

source.title: תקנות הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסים (קופות גמל) (קופת גמל בניהול אישי) (תיקון), התשע"ז-2017 (קובץ התקנות 7819), p.3, reg. 2(ב): 4 × הסכום הקובע 1,575,882 = 6,303,528
source.publisher: Reshumot (Ministry of Justice) – official gazette file service

amount.notes: NOT A YEARLY DEPOSIT CEILING: the total study-fund money that may sit in IRA funds, four times 'הסכום הקובע' counted across all the member's study-fund accounts (reg. 2(א)(1)); within it, study-fund money enters 'from the first shekel'. 2026 figure computed under the regulation from primary inputs (the Tax Authority's minimum pension amount and the Ordinance's multiplier 180; IRA-08); הסכום הקובע = minimum pension amount × capital conversion multiplier × 1.65, so it moves each 1 January with the CPI-linked minimum pension (PEN-28) and the multiplier. The employer and self-employed tax ceilings of a regular study fund still apply to deposits (TXH-08).

labels: F-51 applies the study-fund rules: F-46 at the lawful exit; F-47 (early withdrawal, opt-in) is pending R2
institution source: real base of the 25% on gains from deposits above the benefited amount (TXH-11)
foreign tax withheld inside the account is a cost; treaty relief for an Israeli provident fund is open (TXK-18, TXK OQ7)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance (Wikisource PDF), s.9(2)(a) (fund income exempt), s.9(16A) (study-fund exemption after 6 years); no provision uses "בניהול אישי"

years.notes: As for any study fund: amounts withdrawn are exempt once 6 years have passed since the first payment date of the account (3 at retirement age or for study, TXH-10). Transferring an existing fund into the IRA keeps its seniority (IRA-23, Meitav).

lawful_exit.text: the money becomes free 6 years after the first payment date (3 years at retirement age or for the member's study), as in any study fund; an earlier withdrawal is allowed but taxed (KH-10); a withdrawal or a cash transfer out waits until the holdings the member chose are sold, and what can be sold and when depends on those holdings (IRA-23, IRA-25); deposits and withdrawals stay allowed even while the account is blocked for a breach of the investment limits (IRA-14)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance (Wikisource PDF), s.9(2)(a) (fund income exempt), s.9(16A) (study-fund exemption after 6 years); no provision uses "בניהול אישי"

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Trading inside the account is the fund's own activity: the fund-level exemption of s.9(2)(a) covers any קופת גמל, so sales, dividends and interest inside an IRA are not taxed while the money stays inside (TXK-17). A transfer to another study fund, or between IRA funds (in cash or in kind), is not a withdrawal (IRA-23, TXH-19).

transfer_routes.condition: whole balance only; the receiving company chooses cash or in kind
whole balance only; the member chooses cash or in kind
only money the member could withdraw tax-exempt

eligibility.text: any study-fund member: study-fund money enters from the first shekel, up to four times 'הסכום הקובע' across all the member's study-fund accounts; an employee's fund enters by transferring an existing study fund (the employer keeps paying into a fund the employee chooses), a self-employed member may also deposit directly; the member, or a licensed portfolio manager the member picks, gives the investment instructions; no regulatory minimum was found, and Meitav suggests the product from about NIS 200,000; the member may cancel the agreement at any time without charge

protection.text: the fund's assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and if the company fails management moves to another company; the investment risk is the member's own, with no investment committee; the regulations limit concentration (10% per issuer, 5% options, 10% collateral) and forbid borrowing, and only tradable securities, deposits, structured products, foreign currency and fund units in Israel or an approved foreign country may be held; what protects the securities if the managing company or the broker fails was not found (IRA OQ11), and two IRA managers have had failures since 2023 (press)
